stem: Which message is presented in BOTH the story “The Farm Where Nothing Grew” and the poem “Olivia’s Soccer Practice”?

options.label: A
options.text: Changing your mind about what you want can be good.

options.label: B
options.text: Doing something important to you may take a lot of effort.

options.label: C
options.text: Asking for help can lead you to improve a skill.

options.label: D
options.text: Trying new things may let you learn about yourself.
